answer: Make every new agent post a bond that unlocks only after it passes surprise audits: a verifier hands it a fresh task, like pricing a saffron shipment for a named buyer, and checks the result against a reference. One operator running a thousand clones must lock a thousand bonds and pass a thousand independent audits; clones that just echo each other fail and get slashed. Like a lotus rising from real roots, standing grows only from verified work, so a hollow swarm burns capital and earns nothing.
